whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Downtown Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has an incredible 4.1★ reputation with over 4,200 reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, cafe menu showcase, aur instant WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/downtowncafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team The Downtown Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first menu, table reservation system, and a showcase for your incredible 4,200+ Google reviews right in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
